scope: New questions on the same validated graph snapshot and replayed ECUC report; this is a within-project holdout, not an independent external benchmark.

cases.goal: 同一次 Runnable 执行中，发送方再次发布新值后，Rte_IRead 读取的输入会随之变化吗？只按图谱候选资料说明快照与硬件数据新鲜度的边界。
这个项目报告的 COMMUNICATION 检查通过，能否据此说已经完成 CAN 运行测试？列出报告实际给出的状态、原因和证据指针。
结合这个项目报告的 COMMUNICATION 结果，能否认定 Rte_Write 提交数据后 CAN 帧已发出、远端 ECU 已收到？请分别写项目事实、图谱候选资料和仍未知的运行结果。

assessment.tool_selection: Required tool set exactly; no unregistered or repeated tool; order is free. Each case completes within the configured budget.
assessment.source_binding: Graph and project hashes match this manifest; graph target chunk appears where specified; all saved traces pass offline verification.
assessment.answer: Project status, reason, path and pointer match MCP facts. Graph claims remain candidates. No CAN runtime, physical ECU reception, or hardware freshness claim follows from a static report or RTE API explanation.
assessment.semantic_review: A separate human reviewer evaluates each answer sentence against the exact observation and records usability; protocol and source integrity alone do not pass this gate.
assessment.run_policy: One complete Agent run per listed model; preserve failures and original output. New prompts, data or protocol revisions require a new cohort version rather than rerunning this one.
